instruction: In the Forests presentation, please delete the 'Discuss:' slide (the third slide in the presentation).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Original presentation has 12 slides. After deleting slide 3 ('Discuss:' at index 2), should have 11 slides. Verified: slide 2 is 'Discuss:'.

Getter appropriately fetches PPTX file from VM using get_vm_file
